mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 indicates contraction in real economic activity, triggering reduced consumer confidence and negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles characterized by rising FEDFUNDS above 4.0% and declining CPIAUCSL below 315, increased capital costs and reduced inflation expectations drive negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past 6 months signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor force (PAYEMS) below 159000 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 indicates weakening consumer demand and reduced economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS < 159000 and HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock events characterized by INDPRO below 100 and UNRATE above 4.0%, reduced output and increased joblessness lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during the trigger condition.
